WITH fielding_bats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.bats,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM fielding f
  JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.bats
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM fielding_bats
)
SELECT 
  fb.bats,
  fb.count,
  CAST(fb.count AS FLOAT) / s.total_count as share,
  fb.count - s.avg_count as above_average
FROM fielding_bats fb
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE fb.count > s.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: NULL and empty values in player.bats are each treated as a distinct group (standard SQL GROUP BY behavior for missing values)
Share is expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.25 for 25% of total) rather than as a percentage or other format
